member.name: M:SpireModManager.Api.Banners.Create(SpireModManager.Api.BannerOptions)
member.summary: A banner, not yet in the tree. Its text wraps at the width it's given, and it grows to fit: in a container it fills the width the container gives it (in an HBoxContainer, give it SizeFlags.ExpandFill); under a plain Control, give it a width with anchors or Size, and watch its MinimumSizeChanged for its height. If it can't be made, a plain panel with the text comes back.

member.name: T:SpireModManager.Api.ModCards
member.summary: SMM's card for a mod, as the Modding page's rows show on hover, for your own controls: its picture, name, version, state and problems, author, description, and the player's category, tags and notes.

member.name: M:SpireModManager.Api.ModCards.Watch(Godot.Control,System.String)
member.summary: Shows modId's card while the pointer rests on trigger, with SMM's hover timing (Alt shows it in full), one card at a time across mods. Its loaded copy, else its first installed; built when it opens. Nothing shows for a mod that isn't installed. A second call for the same trigger replaces the mod. A trigger that ignores the mouse (a Label, by default) is set to pass it on (MouseFilter.Pass), so it can be hovered.

member.name: M:SpireModManager.Api.ModCards.WatchLinks(Godot.RichTextLabel,System.Func{System.String,System.String})
member.summary: Shows the card of the mod a link names while the pointer rests on that link: modIdForLink gets a link's meta (its [url=...] value) and gives the mod's id, or null for no card. For [url=mod:id] links: meta => meta.StartsWith("mod:") ? meta[4..] : null. A second call for the same label replaces the mapping. The label's look is left as it is; a mapping that throws shows no card, and is logged once.

member.name: M:SpireModManager.Api.ModCards.Text(System.String)
member.summary: The card's BBCode as it would show now (not in full); null if the mod isn't installed. For self-tests.

member.name: M:SpireModManager.Api.ModCards.Show(Godot.Control)
member.summary: For self-tests: opens the card a Watch set on trigger at once, as a hover would, wherever the real mouse is (below the trigger). It stays up until Close, or until the trigger leaves the tree or is hidden. False if there's no Watch on trigger, or its mod isn't installed.

member.name: M:SpireModManager.Api.ModCards.Close
member.summary: For self-tests: closes the open card (SMM's cards are one at a time, across mods); true if one was open.

member.name: T:SpireModManager.Api.PopupMenus
member.summary: SMM's pop-up menus: an overlay on its own layer, not an engine popup. One open at a time across mods. A press outside or Esc closes it; the screen's hotkeys are off and the keyboard is the menu's while it's open. It closes on its own when its owner leaves the tree or stops being visible. One taller than the screen goes into columns side by side, scrolling up and down past what fits across.
